metadata.description: usadamasa's Claude Code plugins: daemons, hooks and skills for running coding agents, writing in Japanese and measuring Go architecture

plugins.name: agents-daemon
plugins.description: Resident daemon beside Claude Code sessions that does what a session cannot do from inside: resume stopped sessions, aggregate state across sessions, clean up on a clock, operate rex blocks

plugins.name: japanese-writer
plugins.description: Skills, a proofreader subagent and a Stop hook for writing and proofreading Japanese technical documents

plugins.name: go-arch-metrics
plugins.description: Measure and improve Go project modularity and testability with go-arch-lint, golangci-lint and two purpose-built CLIs

plugins.name: dev-workflow
plugins.description: Skills for the development loop: TDD, debugging, verification, code review, finishing a branch and dispatching subagents

plugins.name: shellscript
plugins.description: Skills for writing hardened bash scripts and testing them with bats-core

plugins.name: toolchain
plugins.description: Skills and a direnv hook for placing development tools: Nix devShell, home-manager, PATH and direnv

plugins.name: github-ops
plugins.description: Skills for GitHub issues, Actions CI and local repository operations

plugins.name: harness
plugins.description: Skills and hooks for operating the Claude Code harness itself: writing skills, auditing token usage, PreToolUse guards for Bash and home-directory access, and sandbox troubleshooting

plugins.name: visuals
plugins.description: Skills for diagrams, images and PDFs: Mermaid, Typst, PDF extraction, screen capture and showing images

plugins.name: leadership
plugins.description: Skills for practicing leadership across organizational boundaries
